title: Kottabos Symposium Toss
tagline: Snap your wrist, flick the water and ring the bronze disc.
description: The ancient Greek table game of kottabos: slide and flick the last drops of water from a cup at a balanced bronze disc or at floating cups. Tight streams, a ladder of twelve levels, four computer opponents, two players, Think and Watch & Learn.
howToPlay: Press anywhere and slide toward the target.
Lift quickly: a clean snap keeps the drops together.
Rock the disc off its stand to ring the dish.
Fill the floating cups until they sink.
Tap Think for a tested suggestion.
